messages:
Marta Li: Heads up — ACME Corp wire for $145,200 (inv# 2025-408) hit our bank today but there's no remittance/reference on the transaction. Bank reference: 20250311XYZ. Need help reconciling before EOM.

payments-bot: Ledger import attempted: tx_ref=20250311XYZ amount=145200 status=UNMATCHED reason='no_remittance_id'

Raj Patel: Thanks. Can you paste the bank details (sender bank, beneficiary, SWIFT/IBAN) and the raw trace? I'll open an MT103/trace with our bank contact.

Marta Li: Pasting export from treasury:```date,amount,sender_bank,sender_acc,beneficiary_bank,beneficiary_acc,swift,value_date,bank_ref
2025-03-11,145200,FirstNational Bank,NL12FNAB0001234567,Citibank NA,US98CITI0000123456,CITIUS33,2025-03-11,20250311XYZ```

Alice Chen: Quick check — invoice requires PO on payment. We have PO 98765 on the invoice but the incoming wire has no PO in the narrative. We'll need MT103 or a proof-of-payment (POP) from the payer to clear.

Ben Ortiz: Can we ask Acme to send the MT103 PDF or a bank confirmation? If they can't, ask their bank for a trace (SWIFT UETR/bank trace id). Without that, we can't match reliably for audit.

Marta Li: I just emailed acme.payments@acme.com requesting the MT103/POP and included cc: payments@redwood.com. Subject: "Proof of payment for inv 2025-408 — Redwood Inference".

payments-bot: Support ticket created: FIN-5123 — awaiting customer docs. (assigned: Ben Ortiz) :hourglass: 

Raj Patel: Also ran the local recon tool: `./recon --tx 20250311XYZ --date 2025-03-11` -> no matches, pattern check failed on `remittance_text`. Logs snippet: ```[warn] match_attempt=1 tx=20250311XYZ reason=no_remittance_text [debug] candidate_count=0```

Marta Li: Acme replied with MT103 attached — excerpt from 'Remittance Information / Payment Purpose' field: "PO98765 INV2025-408". Attaching PDF to FIN-5123.

Ben Ortiz: Excellent — that's explicit.

Alice Chen: Matching in ledger now. I'll allocate the payment, move the amount from Suspense->AR, and mark invoice 2025-408 as PAID. Will include MT103 in reconciliation pack.

ledger-bot: Ledger update queued: invoice=2025-408 action=allocate amount=145200 from_account=Suspense to_account=AccountsReceivable status=IN_PROGRESS triggered_by=Alice Chen

ledger-bot: Ledger update: invoice=2025-408 status=PAID payment_ref=20250311XYZ cleared_by=Alice Chen time=1781234890

Marta Li: Closing thread — reconciliation complete, will send confirmation to Acme and upload docs to the audit bucket. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
